topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I knew not the ways of the patent and the inventor's rights when I took to crafting that new plow. It seemed to me a simple thing, an improvement on the old, wearied tools we've known for generations. Yet, now I hear word that another has already laid claim to such a design. It was not my intent to lay a hand in his field, nor to harvest the fruits of another's labors. I was merely trying to ease the toil of our backbent lives, to feed my family a bit more comfortably. I shall have to speak with the lord and the church, find a path that honors both my need and the right of another. May the saints guide me.
